$meta.title: κ_Q characterization ladder — attempt taxonomy
$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of the κ_Q (conditional regularity kernel) characterization-ladder collection. Load first for the shape; follow `detail` pointers to drill in.
$meta.what_is_it: κ_Q = the conditional law of observable outcomes given a σ-algebra refinement Q. The 'ladder' asks how much of a hidden/exogenous variable Z one can characterize from κ_Q alone, level by level.
$meta.status: PARKED 2026-05-28 (Phase-2 gate failed; no contribution-type bar cleared). Revival triggers: (1) the T1 (temperature) level-4 test executes with either-sign verdict; (2) a second application domain resolves the N=1 caveat.
$meta.the_shape: A 4-level attainability ladder. Levels 1–3 are κ_Q-attainable, level 4 is not — the 'limit of definiteness'. Level-1 (existence regime) is a settled NEGATIVE (prior art); level-2 (localisation) a settled POSITIVE (tower monotonicity); level-3 (necessary conditions on Z) is the contribution candidate, audited PARTIALLY-PUBLISHED; level-4 (identity of Z) needs auxiliary info. All contribution-type claims (1/3/4/5/6) audited to FAIL; only Type-7 methodology is CONDITIONAL pending the T1 test.

categories.ladder_level: one rung of the 4-level attainability ladder
categories.candidate_characterization: a level-3 diagnostic or contribution claim, still open
categories.wall: a hard structural obstruction bounding the search
categories.kill: a contribution-type claim audited to fail its bar

ladder_levels.name: Level 1 — Existence regime (a vs b)
ladder_levels.one_line: Whether the existence-regime a/b is discriminable from κ_Q: theorem-level NO, cannot be sharpened. Prior art: Bergna 2026 Prop 1, Heckman–Singer 1984, Allahverdyan 2020, Andrews–Mallows 1974.

ladder_levels.name: Level 2 — Localisation of Z's action
ladder_levels.one_line: Which refinements Q'⊃Q drop R*(Q): YES via tower monotonicity R*(Q')≤R*(Q). The framework's strongest positive guarantee; testable via Deb et al. NPMLEmix (JASA 2022). Applied: MITACS hour_of_week binding axis, α̂_L≈0.575.

ladder_levels.name: Level 3 — Necessary conditions on Z's shape
ladder_levels.one_line: Timescale/continuity/dispersion/between-stratum constraints on Z from within-stratum residual structure. The contribution candidate. Audited PARTIALLY-PUBLISHED (Diggle 1988 variogram is the canonical machinery; the inferential-inversion framing not verbatim).

ladder_levels.name: Level 4 — Identity of Z
ladder_levels.one_line: Which specific variable Z is: NOT from κ_Q alone — needs auxiliary info (candidate-Z test, richer model class, or structural assumption). The boundary / 'limit of definiteness'.

candidate_characterizations.name: Within-stratum ACF (timescale)
candidate_characterizations.one_line: Lag-k decay rate constrains Z's timescale (inspection-only; MITACS within-stratum lag-1 ACF +0.67).

candidate_characterizations.name: Dispersion-ratio (between-stratum)
candidate_characterizations.one_line: Observed < full Σ_Q ⟹ Z has systematic between-stratum effect (inspection-only; under-dispersion observed).

candidate_characterizations.name: Per-stratum mean structure (location)
candidate_characterizations.one_line: Per-day SD variation constrains Z's location-shifting component (inspection-only).

candidate_characterizations.name: Spectral content (broadband vs narrowband)
candidate_characterizations.one_line: Periodogram/wavelet structure rules out narrowband Z; identified but not integrated.

candidate_characterizations.name: Type-7 methodology (level 2→3→4 pivot)
candidate_characterizations.one_line: CONDITIONAL — pre-registered prediction exists (T1: within-cell lag-1 ACF drop from +0.67 toward 0 if T1 sufficient); T1 not yet executed, N=1, no demonstrated advantage yet.

candidate_characterizations.name: T1 (temperature) as level-4 test candidate
candidate_characterizations.one_line: Candidate Z identified; level-3 necessary conditions plausibly satisfied (slow-varying, continuous, weak-week-tie); test planned not executed (MITACS schedule). The primary revival trigger.

walls.name: Shah–Peters impossibility
walls.one_line: Conditional-independence testing without structural assumptions is impossible (Ann. Statist. 2020) ⟹ any characterization of Z requires structural assumptions beyond κ_Q. Hard upper bound.

walls.name: Model-dependence trap
walls.one_line: Z's entry mechanism (mixture / covariate-shift / confounding) must be specified; without fixing it, 'structure of Z' is vacuous. Each mechanism defines a different constraint class.

walls.name: Pearl Causal Hierarchy precedent
walls.one_line: The 4-level tiering is a domain-specific instance of Pearl's Causal Hierarchy ⟹ novelty cannot rest on the tiering idea, only on statistical specifics.

settled_facts.name: Limit of definiteness
settled_facts.one_line: Level 3 is the max attainable from κ_Q alone; level 4 needs auxiliary info. Theorem-level at levels 1 and 4; level-3 boundary claimed not proved-tightest.

settled_facts.name: Level-2 applied evidence (MITACS)
settled_facts.one_line: hour_of_week is the binding axis; α̂_L range 0.575 [0.448,0.648]; Saturday-daytime 0.55–0.61 vs Monday-daytime 0.035.

kills.name: Type-1 (new theorem)
kills.one_line: FAIL — all theorem content (level-1 obstruction, level-2 monotonicity) is prior art (Bergna 2026, Deb 2022, Heckman–Singer 1984).

kills.name: Type-3 (unifying framework)
kills.one_line: FAIL — no demonstrated method transfer between the unified traditions; the unification is organizational (pattern-coincidence), not operative.

kills.name: Type-4 (vocabulary, three-statements test)
kills.one_line: CONDITIONAL FAIL (both rounds) — all three statements are stateable in standard mixed-effects/sensitivity/time-series language; circumlocution ≠ non-stateability.

kills.name: Type-5 (impossibility)
kills.one_line: FAIL — impossibility content entirely prior art (Bergna, Heckman–Singer, Allahverdyan, Andrews–Mallows); the 'limit of definiteness' is a framework assertion, not a proved impossibility.

kills.name: Type-6 (exposition/translation)
kills.one_line: FAIL — inferential inversion is the standing stance of modern sensitivity analysis (Cinelli–Hazlett, Chernozhukov 2024, Manski); practitioner tutorials already serve the audience.

kills.name: Residual-structure-inference seed
kills.one_line: PARKED 2026-05-27 (earlier adjacent seed) — genuine logical gap (non-identifiability ≠ non-constrainability) but every fill either reduces to known math or needs model-dependent assumptions killing the advantage.

open_questions.name: Diggle 1988 framing-inversion novelty
open_questions.one_line: Is 'residual structure reveals Z-properties' verbatim in Diggle 1988? Two-scouts-deep but one-institutional-read shallow (JSTOR main text unread). Verdict shifts if Diggle discusses σ²ρ(u) as missing-covariate evidence.

open_questions.name: Variogram-on-PIT-residuals × Deb-mixture composition
open_questions.one_line: Diggle variogram applied to PIT residuals from a stratified Deb-et-al. mixture estimator — a cross-tradition methodological combination (both components published); organizational, not a theorem.
